info: Campus Treasure Hunt 2.0 Official Questions Configuration

questions.title: The Gathering Haven
questions.question:
Where crowds gather and events come alive,
With a roof overhead, excitement thrives.
From college shows to moments of cheer,
Your next hidden clue is waiting here!

Where should you go?
questions.hint: An open-air gathering spot with a roof overhead for shows and events.

questions.title: The Dining Hall
questions.question:
When hunger strikes, this is the place,
Where food and friends put a smile on your face.
With trays in hand, students gather to eat,
Follow the aroma to find your next treat!

Where should you go?
questions.hint: Where students take trays in hand for meals every day.

questions.title: The Green Arena
questions.question:
No hands allowed when the game is on,
Chase the round ball from dusk till dawn.
Find the place where goalposts stand,
And victory comes with a cheering stand!

Where am I ?
questions.hint: Look for the large green field with goalposts at each end.

questions.title: The Pitch of Glory
questions.question:
A bowler runs, a batter takes aim,
One ball can change the course of the game.
Look for the pitch where stumps stand tall,
And boundaries bring cheers from all!

Where am I ?
questions.hint: The pitch where wickets stand and cricket boundaries are hit.

questions.title: The Fleet's Harbor
questions.question:
I have no engine, yet I host a fleet,
Where journeys pause before moving feet.
Rows of travelers stand still in line,
Find where their wheels rest to uncover your sign.

Where am I ?
questions.hint: Where bikes, scooters, and cars rest their wheels in rows.

questions.title: The Maker's Forge
questions.question:
Where ideas are tested and skills are refined,
Where tools meet talent and hands use the mind.
Things are built, repaired, and brought to life,
Find this place to continue your strive!

Where should you go ?
questions.hint: Where machines, tools, and hands bring designs to life.

questions.title: The Sacred Sanctuary
questions.question:
Where silence speaks and prayers take flight,
A sacred place of peace and light.
With folded hands, people come to pray,
Find me to unlock your next clue today!

Where am I ?
questions.hint: The spiritual and peaceful campus shrine.

questions.title: The Creative Hub
questions.question:
Not a classroom, yet learning takes place,
Not a playground, yet fun fills the space.
Where talents awaken and activities unite,
Find this lively hub to continue your hunt right!

Where am I ?
questions.hint: The campus hub for student clubs, music, drama, and council activities.

questions.title: The Taste of India
questions.question:
A little taste of India, loved by all,
From creamy delights to treats that call.
A famous mascot and a butter-rich name,
Find this spot to continue the game!

Where am I ?
questions.hint: Famous for dairy delights, ice cream, and its iconic butter girl mascot.

questions.title: The Campus Market
questions.question:
From daily needs to snacks galore,
You’ll find many things behind one door.
When something runs out, this is the place to explore,
Find this little market to unlock what’s in store!

Where am I ?
questions.hint: The all-in-one store for snacks, stationery, and daily necessities.

questions.title: Grains & Water
questions.question:
My name speaks of grains and water,
Yet I serve much more to every daughter and son.
Where hungry souls come looking for a feast,
Find this spot to continue your quest!

Where am I ?
questions.hint: The popular eating canopy named after grains and water.

questions.title: The Hall of Wisdom
questions.question:
I hold a thousand worlds but have no doors to roam,
Within my silent walls, curious minds find a home.
No voices are needed for knowledge to speak,
Find where the answers hide, and wisdom you seek!

Where am I ?
questions.hint: Surrounded by quiet study desks, books, and silent readers.

questions.title: The Seat of Control
questions.question:
Behind every rule and official decree,
There’s a place where decisions come to be.
From papers and records to approvals in store,
Find where the college is managed at its core!

Where am I ?
questions.hint: Where student records, paperwork, and administrative affairs are managed.

questions.title: The Southern Kitchen
questions.question:
When hunger calls and stomachs complain,
Students gather here to recharge again.
Not a classroom, nor a place to play,
Find where delicious bites brighten the day!

Where am I ?
questions.hint: The canteen with long benches popular for dosas and South Indian snacks.

questions.title: The Threshold of Journeys
questions.question:
I welcome the many, yet let others depart,
I mark the beginning of every journey's start.
Students pass through me both coming and going,
Find where the campus begins, and your next clue is waiting!

Where am I ?
questions.hint: The main entrance where everyone enters and leaves the campus.

questions.title: The Paper Spitter
questions.question:
I hold no wallet, yet help you spend,
I give you cash when you need a friend.
With a secret code and a card in your hand,
Find me to continue your hunt across the land!

Where am I ?
questions.hint: Where you insert your debit card and enter your PIN for cash.

questions.title: The Fabric Refresher
questions.question:
I deal with stains but never complain,
I turn yesterday’s dirt into freshness again.
Your daily companions arrive in a mess,
And leave looking ready to impress.

Find the place where fabric gets a fresh start!

Where am I ?
questions.hint: Where clothes are washed, dried, and cleaned on campus.

questions.title: The Mentors' Haven
questions.question:
When lectures end and the classrooms grow still,
Some find their rest beyond the hill.
Where those who guide young minds reside,
Your next hidden clue is waiting inside!

Where am I ?
questions.hint: The residential colony where professors and teachers live.

questions.title: The Dancing Waters
questions.question:
I dance without feet and rise without wings,
I sparkle in sunlight like a thousand tiny rings.
I have no voice, yet make a soothing sound,
Look for where flowing water dances round!

Where am I ?
questions.hint: The sparkling water fountain located between the dining halls.

questions.title: The Management Gateway
questions.question:
Where future managers learn to lead,
And business minds are shaped for success indeed.
Beyond these halls, tomorrow’s leaders take flight,
Find the gateway to management and get your next clue right!

Where am I ?
questions.hint: The main entrance/gateway leading into Learning Complex 1 (MBA block).

questions.title: The Summit (Final Destination)
questions.question:
Climb beyond the floors where most people stay,
Head to the highest level to continue your way.
Where the MBA block reaches closest to the sky,
Your next hidden clue is waiting up high!

Where am I ?
questions.hint: The highest floor of LC1 reaching for the sky. Final destination!
